audit.whatIsWrong: Two problems in the chart. The full layer gives Yone all seven rows while content and packet read Orianna / Skill x5 / Orianna. Separately, the content whys were written for the wrong stages: whys[1] (the Level 2 row) discusses 'the level 6 ult interaction', whys[2] discusses first-item trades on the Level 3 row, whys[3] discusses sidelane and roam on the Levels 4-5 row.
audit.why: 48.53% over 2510 games and content that describes an even skirmish support Skill on the middle rows; the full layer is the outlier. The whys are simply offset from their labels (Level 1, 2, 3, 4-5, 6, First item, 2+ items) and describe stages the reader is not looking at.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side -> Orianna, phases[1..5].side -> Skill with whys rewritten to that stage, phases[6].side -> Orianna. whys[1..5] realigned to Level 2 / Level 3 / Levels 4-5 / Level 6 / First item.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer spike rows named only Orianna's spikes; Fate Sealed and his crit item were absent.
audit.why: Fate Sealed is 120/100/80s at 1000 range and blinks behind the last champion in a line, pulling everyone hit toward him; Command: Shockwave is 110/95/80s with a 410 radius. The level 6 row is a mutual ult row, not a doubling of your presence.
audit.corrected: Row 4 now states both ults and the direction each one moves people; row 5 pairs Luden's against his first crit item.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects: the full layer never states an actual interaction — breakdown.cooldowns contained no number and no ability behaviour beyond 'his burst window'.
audit.why: Kit: Soul Unbound 22/19/16/13/10s, spirit leaves the body and on return he repeats part of the damage dealt as a spirit — the body is the punish target. Spirit Cleave is a 14s shield that scales with champions hit. Mortal Steel is a 4s, 450-range poke that dashes and knocks up on the second stack. Orianna answers with E at 9s and R at 110/95/80.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rebuilt on those numbers; dosFull[0].d now explains why the ball sits in his 450 dash lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: Copy-paste bleed in dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[2].d; whys[0] and whys[6] refer to Orianna as 'she/her' instead of addressing the reader as 'you'.
audit.why: Defect-catalogue item 2, plus the second-person voice the quality bar requires — the owner is the reader.
audit.corrected: Bodies rewritten to their titles; whys[0] and whys[6] moved into second person.

edits.after: Yone wins by opening Soul Unbound, stacking Mortal Steel to the knockup, and blinking your backline together with Fate Sealed.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Command: Protect for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.

edits.before: Carry through the ball — no champion controls teamfight space like Orianna; one Shockwave on three is a won game, and you decide when it happens.
edits.after: Carry through the ball — Fate Sealed pulls his victims into one place, so the Shockwave you hold for that blink wins the fight he started.

edits.before: His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.

edits.after: Orianna — you out-range and out-poke a melee Yone at level 1, winning the early trades with ball harass.

edits.before: Skill — the level 6 ult interaction is a reaction coinflip: whoever times R correctly on the other's engage/re-emergence wins.
edits.after: Skill — at 2 his Q is a 4s poke that dashes on the second stack, and your Q-W chunks him back; the wave decides it.

edits.before: Skill — first-item trades hinge on Orianna landing poke vs Yone finding a clean Q3+R all-in window.
edits.after: Skill — your E shield lands at 3, and his Soul Unbound is a 22s spirit dash. Whoever spends first loses.

edits.before: Skill — sidelane and roam decisions are even; Yone's R dive range offsets Orianna's wave control.
edits.after: Skill — through 4-5 his E drops toward 13s and your Q to 4s; trade only while his spirit is on cooldown.

edits.before: Skill — teamfight positioning is a mutual test: her Shockwave value vs his flank timing balance out.
edits.after: Skill — both ults land: his R blinks 1000 behind your line, your R answers it. Reactions decide the row.

edits.before: Skill — scaling and item spikes trade off, so mid-to-late skirmishes depend on execution, not the matchup.
edits.after: Skill — your Luden's poke against his first crit item; he all-ins on the Q3 knockup, you answer with E and R.

edits.before: Orianna — as a premier teamfighter she wins the 5v5 outright when she lands Shockwave on Yone's dive and peels for her team.
edits.after: Orianna — grouped you win outright: Shockwave answers his 1000-range R dive and peels him off whoever he blinked past.
